name: Burpee Broad Jump
steps: Stand at the start of an open lane with feet shoulder-width apart and room to leap forward.
Drop down into a burpee, touch your chest cleanly to the floor, and press back up as your feet jump forward beneath you.
Swing your arms forward and leap explosively with both feet as far ahead as you can comfortably control.
Land softly with bent knees and flat feet, then drop straight into your next burpee forward down the lane.
tips: Absorb every landing smoothly through your hips and knees rather than landing stiff-legged.
Pace your jump length steadily so you maintain clean form across longer distances.
